title: It works
text: It works. It works but if you have a older home say built in the 1890's like mine with the old doors, then do not buy this as the door will not close properly when you try to attach the Velcro piece to the hinge side of the door. These old doors do not have any space for that and it binds the door and will not close. Overall good quality and with a new door it should work well. 3 stars for not testing on old doors !

features: 🔶 Large-size sponge: not ordinary slender sponge, which will not move with the opening of the door.
